cases.purpose: WS routes without upgrade: /v1/responses -> 400 plain-text handshake failure; /v1/realtime -> 426 + Upgrade header; realtime auth uses the nested error envelope.
cases.expected: responses-get-nows: 400 (gorilla handshake failure; plain-text body; Sec-Websocket-Version: 13 header). realtime-get-nows: 426, Upgrade: websocket header, body {"error":{"code":"websocket_upgrade_required","message":"WebSocket upgrade required","param":null,"type":"invalid_request_error"}}. realtime-get-noauth: 401 nested {"error":{..."Missing API key"...authentication_error/invalid_api_key}}. realtime-get-badauth: 401 nested with "Invalid API key".

cases.purpose: Management auth matrix: Bearer and X-Management-Key accept, missing/invalid reject, unknown subroute and wrong-method 404 empty, version headers on all responses.
cases.expected: none: 401 {"error":"missing management key"}. wrong: 401 {"error":"invalid management key"}. bearer/header: 200. apikeys: 200 {"api-keys":["oracle-local-key-1"]}. unknown-subroute + wrong-method: 404 EMPTY body. callback-badstate: 404 {"error":"unknown or expired state","status":"error"} WITHOUT requiring a management key (RECORDED OUTCOME — a syntactically valid but unknown state is 404; 400 invalid state only fires for malformed states: too long, path separators, .., invalid chars). All responses carry X-CPA-VERSION/X-CPA-COMMIT/X-CPA-BUILD-DATE/X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN.
cases.notes: Careful: 5 failed attempts from one IP trigger a 30-minute ban (403 IP banned...). Run the wrong-key probe at most once per recording session, or from a different client IP.

cases.record: response (per request: status + headers + exact body)
notes: Plain baseline config (BOOTSTRAP.md section 3); NO provider attachment needed - every accepted-auth probe terminates at routing with 400 model_not_found (claude envelope), which is itself the proof that the auth gate passed.
Same request body for all probes so the only variable is the credential transport.

Source basis being pinned: internal/api/server_routes.go attaches ONE AuthMiddleware(accessManager) to the /v1 group (and /v1beta); internal/access/config_access/provider.go reads the same five transports for every request through that middleware, and extractBearerToken compares a non-Bearer Authorization header value verbatim.
